reader:from: label of the sender line in the message details, as in “From: Alice”
reader:toLabel: label of the recipients line in the message details, as in “To: Bob”
reader:date: label of the date line in the message details
composer:to: label of the recipients field of a new message
composer:subject: label and placeholder of the subject field
topbar:star: verb: mark a conversation to follow it (toolbar button)
topbar:unstar: verb: stop following a conversation (toolbar button)
topbar:position: position in the list, as in “3 of 16”
reader:show: button that shows blocked remote images
reader:collapse: tooltip of a message header: fold the message
sidebar:sync: button: check the server for new mail now
sidebar:synced: status: time of the last sync, e.g. “Synced 2 min. ago”
settings:save: button that saves the lock settings
settings:copy: button that copies a command to the clipboard
common:keys.shift: name of the Shift key on the keyboard
common:keys.enter: name of the Enter key on the keyboard
common:keys.escape: name of the Escape key on the keyboard
list:reminder.back: badge on a snoozed conversation that has come back
list:reminder.noReply: badge on a conversation where nobody replied in time
nav:views.starred: folder-like view listing the conversations you follow
nav:moves.local.label: stores a copy of the conversation only on this computer, outside any server
scheduled:edit: button that reopens a scheduled message to change it
native:unlockReason: reason shown in the system authentication prompt (Touch ID, Windows Hello); keep it short
native:oauthGranted: plain-text page shown in the web browser after the user allowed Envelope to access their Google/Microsoft account
native:oauthBadState: plain-text page shown in the web browser when the sign-in reply does not match the request Envelope sent
native:mboxFilter: file type name in the system “Save as” dialog for an mbox export
demo:mail.roadmap.subject: demo mailbox (browser preview and screenshots): translating the demo.mail texts is optional, English is used otherwise
